## Chapter Five

Training



Lucas didn’t sleep that night, instead he laid in bed, waiting for Dyson to try something, waiting to become someone else’s plaything, like Anton had tried, but aside from the steady rhythm of the old man sleeping, the night was uneventful. At first bell the two lined up on the tier for breakfast. Lucas looked up and across the bay to see a very surprised Mouse looking down at him, as he tried to understand why his friend was now across the way. Lucas was sad to leave his friend and felt a little guilty, Mouse was the only person he knew, the only person he trusted in here and he had abandoned him without even a thought. However, mixed in with that was also the thought that he was now two tiers below Anton and Grigor and could no longer see them, and for that he was thankful.



The group shuffled to breakfast once they had gotten food, Lucas sat down across from Dyson, eyeing the old man suspiciously. Dyson for his part only smiled as he heartily ate the blue slop before him. “If you try anything, I will kill you” Lucas said with as much malice as he could put into his words. Dyson stopped eating and laid down the plastic spoon he had been using to shovel the unappetizing sludge, he reguarded the young man for a few minutes. And then locking his hard eyes onto the young man he placed both his hands on the table “I am going to say this once, I need you to really listen to me, are you listening?” he said. Lucas leaned back a little trying to put space between the two, but he nodded trying his best to maintain eye contact, he wouldn’t drop his gaze first, he wouldn’t show weakness he kept repeating to himself.



“The only reason you are here, is because I owe a debt and I always pay my debt, the reason isn’t important but from now on, you will do what I say, when I say, you will train every moment of every day, I will instruct you, you will not ask questions, if you cannot do this , then I will have you returned to your old cell and you can take your chances with the likes of Anton, do you understand me?” Dyson finished, his voice hard and even. Lucas weighed his options, he didn’t trust this man, hell he didn’t know this man, but his alternatives were non existent, if he was going to survive this place, then he needed this man who had already proven his ability to defend himself. With a sigh Lucas dropped his eyes and nodded, staring at the table instead of Dyson’s cold calculating glare.



Dyson leaned forward “Look at me” he commanded, and Lucas’s eyes snapped up. “Do you agree” he pressed keeping the young mans gaze. “Yes, I agree” Lucas returned trying to match Dyson’s hard edge to his voice without much success. But the answer seemed to satisfy the older man and he leaned back, dropping his gaze and allowing Lucas off the hook for the moment “good, we start after the yard” he stated and got up from the table.



Walking the yard, like he had done with Mouse Lucas tried to understand the older man, what debt was owed, why was he willing to train him and most important, what the hell did he want? After a while he gave up, he didn’t have enough information and he had no choice but to trust the other man, with his life. As he was making another pass around the tall stone wall, he found Dyson walking next to him, Lucas jumped a bit, he hadn’t even heard the older man approach. “While out in the yard, you will be lifting weights, talk to Lopez” Dyson stated, nodding his heard to a large Latino with long Salt and Pepper hair. “He will get you started, if you are out in the yard, you are working out, if you are not, then I will send you back to your cell, is this understood” he said and before Lucas could answer, he was gone. What a fucking Bastard he thought but making his way over to the weight area.



As he approached the fenced in workout center he was stopped by a bald-headed behemoth of a man “What do you want scrub” he said, the distain for Lucas was practically sliding off of the words. He stood there looking up at the towering figure watching as the man’s eyes hardened and Lucas realized he was gawking “Um, im supposed to see Lopez, Dyson told me to” he stammered out , taking a step back in case this gorilla didn’t like his answer. The man stood there eyeing Lucas and right before the young man was about to Bold heard a musical Spanish cadence coming from inside the fence. “Porter let the poor kid by, before he dies of fright hesse” and laughter filtered from the weight benches around the area. Lucas chided himself as he felt the blush crawl up his neck and onto his face. Porter smiled down at him and then moved out of the way “aww, Lopez, I think you embarrassed the kid” he laughed, his baritone voice resonating over what seemed like the entire yard. Lucas hung his head and made his way over to the short tan skinned latino “Dyson sent me” he mumbled at the ground trying to will away the red of his face. Lucas raised his face to look at Lopez who’s face broke into a friendly smile “oh, he told me to expect you, don’t mind the grumpy old man hesse, but we will get you fit cabrone” he said with an affable tone.



Lucas instantly liked the other man and couldn’t help but return his smile. “What do I do?” he asked him, trying to subtly puff out his chest suddently feeling very, very week in this group of incredibly muscular men surrounding him. Lucas knew he was missing something, these men seemed to defer to Dyson, even following his requests, who is this guy Lucas wondered as he followed Lopez over to sit next to him at a small table in the corner of the workout area.



Turning to the well built latino he looked around and then focused on him “So, am I supposed to lift something?” he asked studying the unknown equipment around him. Lopez laughed and shook his head “No, not yet hesse, first you need to listen, because lifting is a lot more then sitting down and cramming some weights on a bar” he said his tone turning serious. “If you really want to build your muscles, we need to train you to eat, move and think properly before you even lift, otherwise you will waste both of our times and probably hurt yourself in the process.” Lucas nodded, the stereotype in his mind of the mindless weight lifter slowly crumbling.



Lopez looked the young man over, grabbing his arms and studying his profile to the point where he began to feel a bit uncomfortable. “First we need to work on your nutrition, its going to be hard here, being that you only have access to a limited selection, but I am going to give you a meal plan, you are going to follow it, understand” he said, now all business. Lucas nodded, knowing he had little choice, he had to do whatever Dyson instructed if he wanted to survive this place and these people. For the next hour, they discussed what to eat and what not to eat, Lopez took him around the small area and taught him how to lift, and more importantly how not to lift.



“Now, we need to give your body something to build off of, so Protien and Amino acids are going to be critical when choosing your food in the mess” Lopez lectured as they walked around the machines, as if a professor, addressing a student. Lucas listened and tried to keep track of everything the other man was saying, knowing that these things were critical, and failure wasn’t an option. He had never realized there was such a science to building muscle, he had always just assumed it was lifting and more lifting. Walking back into the building his mind swam with how to best optimize his protein intake, how to keep it to thirty or fourty grams to start and then the basic workout regiment that Lopez had dictated to him. The well built Latino had assured him because of Dyson’s mandate, he would have use of any machine at any time reguardless of who was on it and again it caused Lucas to wonder what kind of power his cell mate wielded and why, but more importantly , what was he using it to help a kid he didn’t even know. The questions ate at him, yet he knew better then to voice those to Dyson, so he let them fester resolving to try and solve this little mystery himself.



Once he returned to his cell, he found Dyson sitting on his bunk and reading. “Did you have a good session with Raymon?” he asked as if Lucas had just returned from class instead of the prison yard. It almost caused the young man to laugh, but he caught it before it had escaped. “Yes, I learned a lot” Lucas said. Dyson looked up from the book and reguarded the young man. “Okay, teach me then, what is your plan?” he asked and then waited after putting him on the spot.



Lucas spent the next half hour reiterating his lessons and answering questions until Dyson was satisfied Lucas had taken them to heart. “Now, we train” he stated and rose from the bed, standing on the floor he motioned to Lucas to join him. “We need to ensure you can defend yourself, I won’t always be there to save you” the old man said, but there was a gentle almost paternal tone to his voice that Surprised Lucas, encouraged by the conversation he squared his shoulders at the old man “show me” he said. Dyson sighed and nodded “We will get to that, but there are a few things we need to go over, there is more to defending yourself then just fighting, you need to be aware of your surroundings at all times, the world is not a friendly place, especially in here, you must know what is around you at all times” he stated leveling a serious gaze at the young man to drive home the point. “Now I am going to show you a few moves, that will help you in case you find yourself in a situation you can’t get out of, these are band aids as we train you fully” Dyson stated spreading his feet to shoulder length and motioning for Lucas to do the same. “The first thing you need to know is that striking the soft spots on a body are at the central of any effective move” the old man began and then began pointing to spots on Lucas. “eyes, ears, nose, throat, jaw, solar plexus, throat, groin, knees, shins, toes, now repeat them back to me”.



It took lucas a few tries and after two hours, he could recite them and point them out in a moment, almost as if it was second nature. Dyson smiled approvingly. “There are things you need to notice when entering any room, these are critical in both offense and defense, when entering a room, know where the exits are, ensure you don’t walk into a room voluntarity that only has one exit if you can help it.” He lectured.



Dyson came to stand in front of Lucas adjusting his stance to match his own. “Learn to stand like this naturally, this is the most balanced your body can be should you need to strike, run or defend yourself, your legs are shoulder width, your knees are slightly bent, your arms are loose, and hands are out of your pockets” he continued. Lucas nodding as he did his best to remember knowing Dyson would drill him later.



Taking a breath, Dyson stepped about an arms length from him. “The first thing I am going to teach you is how to defend and attack against an outside strike” he started Lucas nodding eagerly, he desperately wanted to feel safe again, he wanted to feel in control, all things which had been taken from him since this whole nightmare started. “Strike me, just throw a punch” Dyson said. Lucas looked at him, confused until Dyson barked at him “Hit me NOW” and without hesitation Lucas swung at the old man, his right arm coming up in a short haymaker towards his face, but before it got there Dyson’s left arm shot upward to block it and as soon as it made contact his Right hand rocketed forward in a fist and light tapped Lucas on the chin. He stepped back, looking at the old man surprised “What was that?” he asked in awe. He had not even seen it coming and the old guy had moved with lightning competence.



“Let me show you” he said and had Lucas repeat the punch, they spent an hour, with Dyson being the aggressor and Lucas defending. Once he thought the kid had it, Dyson nodded. “Now we move onto the next one. Spinning his finger, he motioned Lucas to turn around, who nodding put his back to the old man. Dyson gently wrapped his arms around him in a bear hug “I want you to do this to me and I will show you how to get out of it” he said and then letting the young man go, turned around. Lucas did as he was told, as soon as he had locked his arms together ensuring he had Dyson in a good hold. He surprised his young student by dropping his weight into a squat, quickly pivoting and then lightly slapping his palm against Lucas’s inner thigh. The kid smiled “Let me try” he said excited, they practiced it again for almost an hour until Lucas felt he had it.



They spent the next few hours before dinner discussing scenario’s, Dyson giving him insight on best to handle it. They made there way into the chow hall, Lucas feeling a little better, as they got their dinner and sat down Dyson’s face became serious “How many cameras did we pass coming in here” he asked suddenly, taking the kid off guard “I don’t know, six maybe” he said, trying to remember. Shaking his head Dyson leaned in “I need you to know at all times what is around you, next time I ask, don’t get it wrong or we are done” he said , his tone hard and all comfort Lucas had built up that day quickly drained away, leaving him feeling emotionally like a deflated balloon, he had almost fooled himself into thinking this guy liked him, or that they could be friends, he resolved not to make that mistake again and simply nodded to the old man, keeping his face neutral.



After dinner they returned to there cell, they had no sooner entered then Dyson spun on him. “You will take these lessons to heart or we are fucking wasting our time, do you understand kid, I have no time for idiots, morons or games” taking Lucas off guard, he quickly nodded “I got it” he said taking a step back from the angry look on Dyson’s face. “How many cameras” he barked “Seventeen” Lucas answered “How many guards” he barked again “four” Lucas answered. Dyson nodded, a smile spreading across his face “good kid, really good” he said and then went to lie down on his bunk, before he did he reached under his pillow and tossed a book to Lucas “read this when we are not training, get through it and we will talk about it” he said. Bringing the book up, Lucas saw Sun Tsu’s the Art of War written across the front. “What the hell is this?” he said confused the old man just smiled. “The start of your true education kid” and then settled into his bunk.



They spent the next morning before breakfast, discussing the chapters he had finished, then reviewing the defense moves from yesterday, before they left for breakfast, he had Lucas recite the contact points for hitting a human body. Once Breakfast was over, they returned to there cell. Where Dyson continued to teach Lucas various martial arts defensive and offensive moves during yard time , he was under Lopez and Porter’s tutelage, spending two agonizing hours lifting and stretching. Returning to his cell Dyson would query him on the number of guards, exits, windows, camera’s anything he could think of to ensure Lucas was paying attention. Then he would read. This was his day, every day for the next few months, every day was the same routine, but getting easier and easier the more he did it, he quickly became proficient in Krav Maga without even knowing its name, he also began to build muscles, the change in both his ability to competently defend himself and the changes to his fitness giving him more confidence in his ability. He finished Art of War and moved onto Miyamoto Musashi’s five rings and then read books on troop movements, logistics, the Roman empire, the picts and more. Every night surprise oral exam by Dyson sometimes on that day’s material, sometimes on something read a week ago, when he passed Dyson would smile like an approving father, but when he didn’t the man would get hard and angry, threatening to abandon the young man.



Lucas spent his days on an emotional roller coaster, but that too helped to mold him, to train him, to make him able to handle life in the prison. The young man began to mature, and he also began to understand the old man more, probably more then the old man wanted him to. He knew Dyson had power here in the prison even if he couldn’t understand why. Inmates treated him with deference when he spoke to them in fact most seemed to damn near worship him.



six months into training, Lucas had been getting progressively better at not only noticing details but also, he was quickly becoming almost a match for the old man in there martial training. This seemed to please Dyson greatly “Like a fish to water” he had said one night while they were reading. His tantrums and threats still happened from time to time but had gotten a lot less as Lucas had grown in both experience and knowledge at the feet of this man whom he barely knew.



Questions and curiosity had been building up in his head for since they had met, it was time to finally ask this man, this mentor. Lucas resolved and that night while they were laying in bed reading, he finaly worked up the nerve to ask.



“Dyson, when we met, you said you owed me, what did you mean?” he asked. Dyson was quiet for a long time, rolling over he peaked his head down towards Lucas’s bunk so he could see the young man “tomorrow” he said and went back to reading. Lucas looked up at the camera in the corner of there cell and thought he understood.



The next day as Lucas was entering the yard after mealtime Dyson intercepted him before he could reach the weight area “walk with me” he said and started towards the edge of the fence line, he said nothing for a bit as they reached the stone wall and began to walk along it, Dyson taking a scan of the yard to know where all the drones and sensors were. Anytime the yard was active three drones would circle above on patrol, it had become so common place that Lucas didn’t even really notice them except to please Dyson and his questions on situational awareness. After thirty feet the old man stopped and pointed at something near the ground, at first Lucas looked at the grass trying to figure out what he was pointing at until Dyson got closer and pointed a small marking on the bottom of the wall, it looked like an upside-down V with an m in the middle of it. Taking three steps beyond it he turned to Lucas “we can talk here” he said eyeing the drone flying above.



“What is that symbol?” Lucas asked glancing back it, he had never noticed it before Dyson had pointed it out. “Start looking at walls and posts, there are markings all over the prison, this one means that there are no listening devices and we can talk freely” he said.  Lucas looked over at the symbol again “Who put them there?” he asked confused Dyson crossed his arms again his eyes never stopping, always roving over the crowd to see if anyone was paying attention.



“Various prisoners , those who resist the governing body of this country, but that is another conversation, I want you to start looking for the markings throughout the prison, see which ones you can point out, I am adding this to your training, we will discuss the ones you find here and only here, you are never to mention it within our cell, is that understood, from here on out, any conversation that doesn’t do with our existing training regiment , only gets discussed here” he fired at Lucas , who just stood there nodding, confused but at least registering the request.



“Now, you asked me a question in our cell, today I will answer it , we won’t have a lot of time to discuss it but I need you to just listen” he stated, again Lucas nodded, leaning forward holding his breath. “I told you I owed a debt, but it wasn’t to you, it was a debt to your late father” Dyson said as if dropping a bomb. A million questions went through his mind as he tried to process what the old man had just told him. But he had been trained well and held his tongue letting Dyson get it out in his own way. The old man was agitated as he tried to organize his thoughts , finally he laughed shaking his head “You know , I thought I had this all worked out in my head about how I would tell you this, but I really don’t so here it is” he said again his eyes always watching everything, he leaned in his eyes locking with Lucas’s “Your father worked for me”.
